environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no header filtering. gRPC services are on the same VPC with no mTLS or metadata validation. Dashboard template uses dynamic script_url from gRPC response without SRI enforcement (integrity attribute helper returns empty string in development mode). Content-Security-Policy header is set to 'unsafe-inline' for backward compatibility with legacy widgets.
